implementation: watcher-gated incremental snapshot (worktree watcher short-circuits noop captures)
machine: Apple Silicon, node v26.7.0, tmpfs-backed tempdir
notes: noopMedianMs is now O(1) (~0.003ms) at every scale: when the worktree watcher reports no change since the last capture, capture() returns the cached tree without spawning git. This is the fix for prompt-start latency (the audit's 15s was O(total) enumeration on every capture). hotMedianMs is the unavoidable O(N) full enumeration that only runs when files actually change (turn-end, after the model responds). firstCaptureMs is the one-time cold cost to init the shadow repo + watcher.
